Politics · India

Kejriwal seeks clarity on E20 fuel impact from automakers

Delhi Chief Minister Arvind Kejriwal has written to 29 car manufacturers seeking clarification on the impact of E20 fuel on vehicle mileage. The move comes amid concerns over the environmental and economic effects of the new fuel standard. Kejriwal's letter seeks written assurances from the companies, which will be reviewed by the Delhi government.
